references.text: Gershom's sons Libni and Shimei are also mentioned when Jacob's family travels to Egypt, confirming the lineage.
Repeats the names of Gershon's sons Libni and Shimei in connection with the Levites' census.
The families of Libni and Shimei are mentioned as the clans of Gershon.
The Levitical clans, including the family of Libni and the family of Shimei, are listed.
Repeats that Gershon's sons were Libni and Shimei in the genealogical records of Chronicles.
The names of Gershon's sons, Libni and Shimei, are repeated in the Levitical genealogy.
Gershom's sons Ladan and Shimei are mentioned in connection with the Levites' service under David.
Expands the picture from naming to practical organization and duty of service for the same clans.
